Aries.name: Aries
Aries.summary: Bold, pioneering, and full of initiative. Aries energy drives action and leadership.

Taurus.name: Taurus
Taurus.summary: Practical, grounded, dependable and emotionally stable.

Gemini.name: Gemini
Gemini.summary: Curious, communicative, and adaptable. Gemini thrives on variety and intellectual exchange.

Cancer.name: Cancer
Cancer.summary: Nurturing, intuitive, and deeply connected to home and family.

Leo.name: Leo
Leo.summary: Radiant, creative, and confident. Leo expresses warmth and natural leadership.

Virgo.name: Virgo
Virgo.summary: Analytical, precise, and service-oriented. Virgo seeks perfection through practical wisdom.

Libra.name: Libra
Libra.summary: Harmonious, diplomatic, and drawn to beauty and balanced relationships.

Scorpio.name: Scorpio
Scorpio.summary: Intense, transformative, and perceptive. Scorpio penetrates beneath the surface.

Sagittarius.name: Sagittarius
Sagittarius.summary: Optimistic, philosophical, and freedom-loving. Sagittarius seeks truth and expansion.

Capricorn.name: Capricorn
Capricorn.summary: Ambitious, disciplined, and structured. Capricorn builds lasting foundations.

Aquarius.name: Aquarius
Aquarius.summary: Innovative, humanitarian, and independent. Aquarius envisions the future.

Pisces.name: Pisces
Pisces.summary: Compassionate, imaginative, and spiritually attuned. Pisces flows with intuition.
